about_the_game:
LIFTED is a cinematic adventure that feels like stepping into your favorite childhood movie, created by former Disney ride designer. Perfect for Steam Deck.

It is warm, funny, and just a little ridiculous in the best way.

A Reckless Time Travel Heist

Slacker Ari Buktu only pokes his head into Professor Raventhorpe’s lab for extra credit. Seconds later he is hurtling through history on a reckless mission to steal a legendary tiara and fix the professor’s love life. Each stop opens a new era and a bigger puzzle, with the shadow of a rival tomb raider always one jump behind.

An original and flowing journey

No combat. No heavy systems. No filler. Just a steady flow of set pieces, adventure puzzles, and intuitive platforming that keep the story flying.

A story for everyone

Kids will see a playful treasure quest. Adults may find a story about chasing love and discovering who you are. Everyone gets a few hours of pure feel good adventure.

Key features

  • Playable adventure film

  • Story first design with approachable puzzles and platforming

  • Time travel through exotic locations, deserts, jungles, snowy mountains, and pirate harbors.

  • Family friendly tone with no graphic violence

  • A complete journey you can finish in a few play sessions

  • Single player
